## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-fascicle compilation by [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) of supplementary notes on [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016) *Chéng wéishí lùn* — material that, like that in the companion [KR6n0033](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0033) *liàojiǎn*, did not enter the principal commentary [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *shùjì* but was preserved in circulation. The "*bié chāo*" 別抄 ("separate excerpts") title indicates that the text is in part an aggregation of marginal notes and lecture-records assembled by Kuījī (or by his disciples) outside the formal commentarial framework.

**Abstract**

The *biéchāo* is preserved only in the *Xuzangjing* (X48n0808). Like its companion [KR6n0033](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0033), it preserves Kuījī's working notes on doctrinal cruces of the *Chéng wéishí lùn* — particularly on questions of the *xiànxíng* / *bīja* relation, the *manas*-*ālayavijñāna* relation, and the bodhisattva-bhūmi correlations — that fell outside the topical organisation of the principal commentaries.

Modern Yogācāra scholarship has paid increasing attention to the *biéchāo* and *liàojiǎn* together as evidence for Kuījī's doctrinal development across his teaching career: positions taken in these working notes sometimes anticipate or refine those in the *shùjì*, suggesting (Yoshimura, 2013) that Kuījī continued revising his understanding of the *Chéng wéishí lùn* throughout the 660s and 670s. The dating window adopted (659–682) covers Kuījī's full teaching career.
